name: DyGraphQA
description: DyGraphQA is a benchmark dataset for evaluating LLMs' reasoning capabilities on dynamic graphs, including fully dynamic cases with node and edge additions/deletions. It includes prompts in natural language and structured data formats to test reasoning over changing graph structures.
reputation: A newer benchmark for dynamic-graph reasoning that has seen limited but growing use in graph-LLM evaluation.
notes: Includes two settings: natural language graph descriptions and structured data; highlights challenges in dynamic graph reasoning.
